description: Logging and assertions: every library's runtime log and assert hooks route to one facade.

log_hook.description: The runtime API that redirects the library's log output, or null if it has none.

assert_hook.description: How the library's assertion failures can be redirected, including any build condition, or null.

query.description: How glue reads the installed hooks back, or null.

rules.text: Every runtime log and assert hook the library offers is set to the facade's handler, and a smoke run that makes the library log reaches the facade. A library with no runtime hook records not-applicable with that reason; a hook that exists only under a build condition the run doesn't meet records unverifiable.
A library assertion that fails in a shipping build reaches the facade's fatal handler or is compiled out; it never terminates the process silently.
